scripts.postinstall: set -e; for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm install 2>&1); done
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,user-svc,classes,registration,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green -c auto "cd backend && npm run start:dev" "cd user-service && npm run start:dev" "cd classes-service && npm run start:dev" "cd registration-service && npm run start:dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.lint: set -e; for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run lint 2>&1); done
scripts.format: set -e; for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run format 2>&1); done
scripts.typecheck: set -e; for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run typecheck 2>&1); done
scripts.test: set -e; for d in backend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm run test -- --passWithNoTests 2>&1); done
scripts.audit:fix: set -e; for d in backend frontend user-service classes-service registration-service; do (cd "$d" && echo "=== $d ===" && npm audit fix 2>&1); done
